<style>
:root {
  --navy: #1c4279;
  --blue: #087fb5;
  --blue-hover: #066a98;
  --pale: #eaf5fc;
  --page: #f4f9fc;
  --border: #dce7f1;
  --text: #183b68;
  --muted: #607b99;
  --yellow: #f5d52a;
}
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--page);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
}
body { padding: 0 !important; }
.main-container {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}
#header, .title { display: none; }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
.top-strip {
  height: 28px; background: var(--navy); color: white;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 22px; font-size: 10px;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--blue);
}
.brand-header {
  min-height: 72px; background: white; display: flex;
  align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.logo {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; border: 2px solid #e2b900;
  color: var(--navy); border-radius: 50%; display: grid;
  place-items: center; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;
  background: #fffdf1;
}
.brand-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
.brand-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; margin-top: 3px; }
.header-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.btn-ui {
  display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; text-align: center;
  transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-hover); color: #fff; }
.btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--navy); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--pale); border-color: #b8d8ea; color: var(--navy); }
.app-shell { display: flex; min-height: calc(100vh - 100px); }
.sidebar {
  width: 190px; flex: 0 0 190px; background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff; padding: 18px 12px;
}
.sidebar-title {
  font-size: 11px; margin: 0 0 12px; color: #fff;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .2px;
}
.nav-item {
  display: block; padding: 9px 7px; border-radius: 3px;
  color: #f5f8fc; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px;
  transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease;
}
.nav-item:hover { background: #28558e; color: #fff; }
.nav-item.active { color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 700; }
.sidebar .website {
  display: block; margin-top: 12px; background: white; color: var(--navy);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center; padding: 10px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none;
}
.sidebar .website:hover { background: var(--pale); }
.content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 24px 28px 36px; }
.breadcrumb { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.page-heading {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
h1 { font-size: 24px; margin: 0; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; }
.heading-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.book-summary {
  background: var(--pale); padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
  line-height: 1.7; color: var(--navy);
}
.book-summary strong { font-weight: 600; }
.book-summary .meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto; background: white; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
table.book-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: white; }
.book-table th {
  text-align: left; background: var(--pale); color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.book-table td {
  padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.book-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.book-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f0f8fd; }
.table-link { color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.table-link:hover { color: var(--blue-hover); text-decoration: underline; }
.form-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;
}
.field label { display: block; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--navy); }
.field input, .field select {
  width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 9px 11px;
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text); font: inherit; outline: none;
  transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}
.field input:focus, .field select:focus {
  border-color: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(8,127,181,.12);
}
.form-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.status { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 12px; min-height: 16px; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .brand-header { padding: 12px 16px; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; flex-direction: column; }
  .app-shell { display: block; }
  .sidebar { width: 100%; }
  .content { padding: 20px 16px; }
  .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .page-heading { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
  h1 { font-size: 21px; }
}
</style>

  <main class="content">

        <button class="btn-ui btn-primary" type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('ma-ban-sach').focus(); document.getElementById('ui-status').textContent='Nhập mã bản sách bổ sung ở biểu mẫu bên dưới.'">+ Nhập bản sách</button>

    </div>

        <thead>

    <form id="supplement-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); var code=document.getElementById('ma-ban-sach').value.trim(); var loc=document.getElementById('vi-tri').value.trim(); if(!code){document.getElementById('ui-status').textContent='Vui lòng nhập mã riêng của cuốn sách.'; document.getElementById('ma-ban-sach').focus(); return;} document.getElementById('ui-status').textContent='Đã ghi nhận dữ liệu mẫu: '+code+' · '+loc+'. Đây là giao diện demo, chưa lưu vào cơ sở dữ liệu.';">
      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="ma-ban-sach">Mã bản sách nhập bổ sung</label>
          <input id="ma-ban-sach" name="ma-ban-sach" type="text" placeholder="Nhập mã riêng của cuốn sách..." autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="field">

      </div>
      <div id="ui-status" class="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </form>

<script>
function navMessage(name) {
  document.getElementById('ui-status').textContent = 'Mục "' + name + '" được minh họa trong mẫu giao diện.';
  return false;
}
function rowAction(message) {
  document.getElementById('ui-status').textContent = message + ' (demo UI, chưa kết nối nghiệp vụ).';
  return false;
}
</script>
